Name: Hopper Collector
Author: mistanervous
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Hopper Collector extends the vanilla hopper to enable light automation. Hoppers will automatically pull finished output from adjacent machines and deposit it into a nearby chest. If no chest has space, items stay in the machine until room opens up. Hoppers will also re-feed themselves into idle machines from their own inventory, keeping your production lines running hands-free. This is for players who don't want the full scale changes made by mods like Automate.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it into [size=3]your mods folder.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Hoppers automatically collect finished output from directly adjacent machines.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Collected items are deposited into any chest within one tile of the hopper.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If no chest has space, the item stays in the machine until room opens up.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Hoppers re-feed idle machines from their own inventory automatically.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Works across all locations including barns, sheds, cellars, and coops.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional) — for the in-game enable/disable toggle.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Source Code[/b][/size]
[size=3][url=https://github.com/nick-castro-1/HopperCollector]Github repository[/url][/size]
